body:
I was having a miserable first day back from spring break, and decided to lighten things up, not a bit, a lot, with 6 25mg Flexeril.  I took these forgetting I hadn't eaten anything for the past week, and within minutes was retarded. I fell asleep in every one of my classes, and literally couldn't speak.
THAT was a day to forget.
